summary: Bemidji's 1935 fire tower was moved to Camp Wilderness in 2007 and rebuilt at 80 ft; the Bemidji site is listed as gone, and a 1960 survey note gives 110 ft.

corrections.current: None relocated (The lookout was moved to Camp Wilderness.)
corrections.proposed: relocated 2007 to Camp Wilderness, Hubbard County; rebuilt as an 80-foot tower
corrections.why: The register and the county report both record the 2007 move, so the claim that nothing was relocated is wrong.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the county report give 100 ft; the 1960 survey description gives an overall height of 110 ft. The story and height_m use 100 ft from the two documents that describe the tower itself, and the survey figure is noted.
The register and the county report give 1935; the 1960 survey description says the survey station was established in 1938 and gives no build year for the tower. The story uses 1935.
The county report calls the new site a private camp; the register names the Boy Scouts' Northern Lights Council as administrator. Both are reported in the story.

notes_for_editor: The move to Camp Wilderness, the 80-foot rebuild and the Bemidji site listed as gone are well sourced. Build year and height are not settled: the 1960 survey description says 110 ft and gives no build year. Access: no public climbing hours found on the Camp Wilderness page. The county report's 'disabled for climbing' line belongs to the Blackduck tower (Tower 87), not Bemidji, so it is not used. Camp Wilderness is covered by the sibling record us-mn-bemidji-at-camp-wilderness, which uses the same sources. The record's agency field is correct.
